login.title: Sign in to CleanOS
login.subtitle: Use the account your administrator gave you.
login.invalid: That email and password do not match an account.
login.noProfile: Your login exists but has no profile in CleanOS. Ask your administrator to add you.
login.demoHint: Seeded by npm run db:seed. Password:

setup.title: CleanOS is not connected to Supabase yet
setup.intro: The app is installed, but it has no database or login service to talk to. Add these to your .env file, then restart the server.
setup.where: Every one of these is explained in .env.example, including where to copy it from in your Supabase dashboard.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.phaseNotice: Phase 1 of 8 is complete: accounts, roles, database and demo data. The screens below arrive in later phases.

todo.heading: {feature} arrives in Phase {phase}
todo.body: This screen is deliberately empty. It is a placeholder so you can see the navigation, not a broken page.

field.title: Today's jobs
field.noStaffRecord: Your login is not linked to an employee record yet. Ask the office to set that up — until then no jobs can be shown.

clock.noLocation: We could not read your location. Saved anyway — the office will check it.
clock.farAway: Recorded {metres} m from the address. Saved anyway — the office will check it.

photos.title: Photos
photos.failed: That photo could not be added.
photos.storageOff: Photo storage is not set up yet, so photos cannot be added. Everything else on this job works normally.

issue.title: Report a problem
issue.body: This goes straight to the office. You do not need to phone anyone.
issue.subject: In a few words
issue.detailPlaceholder: Found on arrival, before we started. Photo added.
issue.noAccessNote: Reporting no access also marks this job as no-access, so the office can see it straight away.

meta.title: Professional cleaning in Dubai
meta.description: Regular, deep and move-in cleaning for homes and offices across Dubai. Get an instant price in under a minute.

hero.title: A cleaning company that shows up on time
hero.subtitle: Vetted, trained and insured teams. An instant price with no phone calls, no site visit and no haggling — the number you see is the number you pay, VAT included.

rated.title: Rated after every visit
rated.body: Below 4 stars, we come back free

services.title: What we clean
services.subtitle: Prices for every service below come from our live rate card.

calculator.title: Your instant price
calculator.subtitle: No phone call needed. Change anything and the price updates.
calculator.unavailableBody: Please call us and we will quote you directly.
calculator.referralUnknown: We do not recognise that code, so no discount was applied.
calculator.emailHint: So we can send you the quote as a PDF.
calculator.source: How did you hear about us?
calculator.privacy: We use your details only to quote and schedule your clean.

done.title: Thank you — we have your enquiry
done.body: Your quote {quoteNo} is confirmed and our team will call you shortly.
done.emailed: We have emailed your quote as a PDF.
done.emailFailed: We could not email your quote right now, but we have it saved and will call you.
done.whatsapp: Send us the details on WhatsApp

leads.title: Leads
leads.subtitle: Every enquiry, from first contact to won or lost. Website enquiries arrive here automatically.
leads.dragHint: Drag a card between columns to move it. Marking a lead as lost asks you why.

stats.conversionHint: Won as a share of decided leads

lostDialog.title: Why was this lead lost?
lostDialog.body: Recording the reason is what turns a lost deal into something you can learn from.

detail.notePlaceholder: Called, asked us to try again next week…

clients.title: Clients
clients.subtitle: Everyone who pays you, with their properties, access notes and referral performance.
clients.searchPlaceholder: Search name, phone, email or code…

referral.title: Referrals
referral.explain: This client earns {amount} each time somebody books with their code.
referral.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the code by hand.
referral.none: Nobody has used this code yet.

controls.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can change billing terms.
controls.bookingHint: A paused client cannot book until you resume them.
controls.notesPlaceholder: Prefers morning slots. Always tips the team.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Teams down the side, days across the top.
schedule.dragHint: Drag a job onto another team or day. A move that would put a team in two places at once is refused; anything merely tight asks you first.
schedule.generateDone: Created {count} visits from your repeating bookings
schedule.generateNothing: Nothing to create — the diary is already filled in
schedule.generateSkipped: {count} were skipped because the team was already booked

conflict.title: Are you sure about this move?
conflict.body: It is possible, but it looks difficult. You may know something the schedule does not.
conflict.doubleBooked: This team is already on job {jobNo} at that time.
conflict.travelTime: Only {gap} minutes between {from} and {to}, but the drive alone takes {drive} minutes ({needed} needed with the buffer).
conflict.overCapacity: That day would be {booked} minutes against a capacity of {capacity} — over by {over}.
conflict.outsideShift: This falls outside the team's shift of {start} to {end}.
conflict.nonWorkingDay: This team does not normally work on {weekday}.
conflict.teamOnLeave: The whole team is on approved leave that day.

detail.skipped: Visit skipped — the series carries on
detail.lateWithFee: Only {hours} hours' notice — a late-cancellation fee of {fee} applies.
detail.lateNoFee: Only {hours} hours' notice. Recorded as late, but you charge no fee.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Every visit, past and upcoming, with its team and price.
jobs.searchPlaceholder: Search job number, client or phone…

series.title: Repeating bookings ({count})
series.explain: Pausing one stops NEW visits being created. Visits already in the diary stay exactly as they are.
series.clientPaused: This client is paused from booking, so no visits will be created.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.subtitle: Every VAT invoice, what has been paid, and what is still owed.
invoices.clientPaused: {name} is paused from booking because of unpaid invoices. Recording a payment does not unpause them — do that on the client's page.
invoices.readOnly: You can view this invoice, but only the owner can record payments or issue credit notes.
invoices.voided: This invoice has been voided. Nothing further can be recorded against it.

stats.overdueHint: Past their due date and unpaid

aging.title: Aged receivables
aging.hint: How old the money owed to you is, counting from each due date.

run.nothing: Nothing to invoice — every completed job for monthly clients is already on an invoice.
run.done: Raised {count} invoices for {clients} clients, {total} in total.
run.noReminders: No reminders are due right now.
run.remindersPartly: Sent {sent}, but {failed} could not be sent.
run.paused: {count} clients were paused from booking for non-payment.

record.title: Record a payment
record.overpayWarning: That is {extra} more than the balance. The extra becomes credit on the client's account.
record.stripeOff: Card payments are not set up. Add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to .env.

reminders.title: Payment reminders
reminders.none: No reminders scheduled for this invoice.

credit.title: Issue a credit note
credit.body: A tax invoice is never deleted. A credit note cancels part or all of it and leaves a trail an auditor can follow.
credit.max: You can credit up to {amount} against this invoice.
credit.tooMuch: That is more than is left to credit on this invoice.
credit.refundHint: Sends the money back through Stripe to the card that paid.

retention.title: Retention
retention.subtitle: Who is drifting away, what clients think of the work, and who is bringing you new business.

risk.title: Clients at risk
risk.hint: Worst first. Nobody phones up to say they are leaving.
risk.empty: Nobody is showing warning signs. Press Rebuild to check again.
risk.resolveBody: Say what you did, so the next person looking at this client can see it.
risk.notePlaceholder: Called them, moved the clean to Thursdays…

ratings.title: Recent ratings
ratings.hint: {low} below {threshold} stars in 90 days · {awaiting} still waiting for a reply
ratings.google: Google review offered {shown} times, clicked {clicked} times.

nps.title: Would they recommend you? ({quarter})
nps.empty: No answers this quarter yet — {outstanding} surveys are out.
nps.outstanding: {count} surveys sent but not yet answered.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.buildBody: These clients have gone quiet. Untick anyone you would rather not message. Nothing is sent until you approve the draft.
campaigns.working: Working out who has gone quiet…
campaigns.nobody: Nobody is due a win-back offer right now.
campaigns.drafted: Draft created for {count} clients. Nothing has been sent yet.
campaigns.ownerOnly: Only the owner can create a campaign.
campaigns.approveBody: This sends a message to {count} clients right now. It cannot be taken back.
campaigns.partlySent: Sent to {sent}; {failed} could not be reached.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.hint: {rewarded} rewarded · {pending} waiting to qualify · {paid} paid out

run.done: Sent {ratings} rating requests and {surveys} surveys; rewarded {referrals} referrals.

rate.title: Rate your clean
rate.punctuality: Did the team arrive on time?
rate.comment: Anything you would like to add? (optional)
rate.commentLow: What went wrong? This goes straight to the manager.
rate.commentPlaceholder: Tell us as much or as little as you like…
rate.lowWarning: A manager will read this and be in touch. We would rather fix it than lose you.
rate.thanksHigh: We are glad it went well. See you next time.
rate.thanksLow: We are sorry. A manager has been notified and will be in touch shortly.
rate.googlePrompt: Would you share that on Google? It genuinely helps a small business.
rate.alreadyBody: You gave this clean {stars} stars. Thank you — job {jobNo}.

nps.title: One quick question
nps.question: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend or colleague?
nps.commentPromoter: Thank you! What do we do best? (optional)
nps.thanksBody: That takes ten seconds and it genuinely shapes what we fix next.
nps.alreadyBody: You scored us {score} out of 10 this quarter. Thank you.

staff.title: Staff & HR
staff.subtitle: Who works for you, whose papers are about to lapse, and which hours are payable.
staff.searchPlaceholder: Search name, employee number or phone…
staff.blockedWarning: {count} people cannot legally be sent to a job today — their papers have lapsed. Scheduling them anyway is your fine, not theirs.

stats.blockedHint: Visa, Emirates ID or labour card lapsed

compliance.cannotWorkLong: This person must not be sent to a job until their papers are renewed. The fine for sending them lands on you, not on them.

leave.approvedWithJobs: Approved — but {count} jobs are booked with them in that period.
leave.recrewHint: Nothing was cancelled. Re-crew those jobs on the schedule.

timesheets.title: Hours to review
timesheets.hint: Clocked in or out away from the property. Not payable until you decide.
timesheets.none: Nothing to review — every clock-in matched its address.
timesheets.reviewBody: The GPS did not match the property. Approving makes these minutes payable; refusing does not.
timesheets.notePlaceholder: Called the team lead, they were parked around the corner…

documents.title: Legal documents
documents.none: No documents recorded. A visa with no expiry date cannot be warned about.
documents.body: The expiry date is what the 60/30/7-day warnings watch. Without it, nothing is sent.
documents.renewedHint: Changing the expiry date starts the warnings again from scratch, so the new expiry gets its own 60, 30 and 7-day reminders.

pay.title: Pay
pay.noIban: No IBAN recorded — they cannot be included in a WPS file.
pay.wpsNote: CleanOS never processes salaries. These are the figures you hand to your bank.
pay.hidden: Only the owner can see what staff are paid. The database refuses these fields to every signed-in session independently.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: What is on the shelf, what needs ordering, and which machines are due a service.

stats.stockValueHint: At cost, not at what you charge
stats.machinesDownHint: In repair, lost, or overdue a service

ledger.title: Recent stock movements
ledger.hint: Every number above is the sum of these — nothing is typed in directly.

movement.adjustBy: Correct by how much? (minus to reduce)
movement.wouldGoNegative: This would leave {qty} — more than you have. It will be recorded anyway, so the count stays honest.
movement.notePlaceholder: Invoice number, which van, why it was wasted…
movement.negativeWarning: Recorded, but the count is now {qty}. Check the shelf — something was taken without being logged.

maintenance.body: {tag} — recording a service schedules the next one automatically from this machine's own interval.
maintenance.savedNoInterval: Recorded. No service interval is set for this machine, so nothing was scheduled.
